label: pelvic floor muscle
definition: A group of skeletal muscles that form the floor of the pelvic cavity, supporting the pelvic viscera and surrounding the urogenital and anal openings, comprising the levator ani and coccygeus muscles.
reason: No UBERON term currently exists for 'pelvic floor' or 'pelvic diaphragm' as an anatomical region — only the constituent muscles (levator ani UBERON:0001326, coccygeus UBERON:0001327) and the broader pelvic region (UBERON:0002355) are represented. The simple genus + part_of pattern needs a target term for the pelvic floor itself.
similar_terms: UBERON:0001325=muscle of pelvis; UBERON:0001326=levator ani muscle; UBERON:0001327=coccygeus muscle
suggestion: Either (a) add a new region term 'pelvic floor' / 'pelvic diaphragm' and define this group as skeletal muscle organ part_of that, or (b) define as has_part levator_ani and has_part coccygeus, or (c) treat as a subclass of muscle of pelvis (UBERON:0001325) without an EC definition.

label: dorsum of foot muscle
definition: A group of skeletal muscles located on the dorsal aspect of the foot, comprising the extensor digitorum brevis and extensor hallucis brevis, which act to extend the toes.
reason: No UBERON term exists for 'dorsum of foot' / 'dorsal region of pes' as a region. The only dorsal pes term found is UBERON:0006499 dorsal pes interosseous muscle (a specific muscle, not a region). Simple genus + part_of pattern cannot be applied without a region target.
suggestion: Add a new region term 'dorsal part of pes' (analogous to UBERON:0008338 plantar part of pes) and define this group as skeletal muscle organ part_of that region. Alternatively define by membership (has_part extensor digitorum brevis, has_part extensor hallucis brevis).

label: longitudinal pharyngeal muscle
definition: A group of skeletal muscles oriented longitudinally in the pharyngeal wall that act to elevate the pharynx and larynx during swallowing, comprising the stylopharyngeus, palatopharyngeus, and salpingopharyngeus muscles.
reason: This is a sub-grouping of pharyngeal muscles defined by fibre orientation (longitudinal) within the pharyngeal wall — not a simple part_of-defined subset. UBERON's circular counterpart (UBERON:0001569 constrictor muscle of pharynx) is is_a UBERON:0000933 chordate pharyngeal muscle without an EC axiom on orientation. The simple genus + part_of pattern cannot express fibre orientation.
similar_terms: UBERON:0001569=constrictor muscle of pharynx; UBERON:0000933=chordate pharyngeal muscle
suggestion: Either model as subclass of chordate pharyngeal muscle (UBERON:0000933) without an EC, mirroring how UBERON:0001569 is handled, or add a new relation/property for muscle fibre orientation. Note that circular pharyngeal muscle (the sibling) maps directly to UBERON:0001569 — see confirmed_matches.

label: superficial back muscle
definition: A grouping of skeletal muscles forming the superficial (appendicular) layer of the back, attaching the upper limb to the trunk and acting on the shoulder girdle, comprising the trapezius, latissimus dorsi, levator scapulae, and rhomboid muscles.
reason: Genus (UBERON:0014892) + part_of dorsum (UBERON:0001137) is identical to the EC axiom for intermediate back muscle and segmental back muscle (siblings differentiated by anatomical layer, innervation source, and function — not by part_of location). Members are innervated by anterior rami and developmentally extrinsic to the back.
similar_terms: UBERON:0004469=musculature of back; UBERON:0002324=muscle of back; UBERON:0035112=intrinsic muscle
suggestion: Handled manually as UBERON:9900063 with is_a UBERON:0004469 (musculature of back). See terms/hra-muscular-back-groups.obo on branch add-hra-muscular-ntr.

label: intermediate back muscle
definition: A grouping of skeletal muscles of the back, intermediate in depth between the superficial appendicular group and the deep intrinsic group, comprising the serratus posterior superior and serratus posterior inferior muscles.
reason: Genus + part_of dorsum collides with superficial and segmental back muscle EC axioms. Differentiated from siblings by anatomical layer and respiratory accessory function, not by part_of location. Members are innervated by anterior rami.
similar_terms: UBERON:0004469=musculature of back; UBERON:0002324=muscle of back
suggestion: Handled manually as UBERON:9900020 with is_a UBERON:0004469. See terms/hra-muscular-back-groups.obo on branch add-hra-muscular-ntr.

label: segmental back muscle
definition: A grouping of small skeletal muscles of the deep (intrinsic) back that span individual vertebral segments, comprising the interspinales, intertransversarii, and levatores costarum muscles.
reason: Genus + part_of dorsum collides with superficial and intermediate back muscle EC axioms. This grouping is conventionally a subdivision of the deep (intrinsic) back muscle group, alongside spinotransversales, erector spinae, and transversospinales. Differentiated from siblings by segmental span and innervation by posterior rami.
suggestion: Handled manually as UBERON:9900055 with is_a UBERON:0004469. Once a 'deep back muscle' grouping is added, this term should be re-parented under it. See terms/hra-muscular-back-groups.obo on branch add-hra-muscular-ntr.
